$comment: Cross-language PHI redaction contract. Single source of truth for the redaction policy shared by the Viktor backend logger (backend/viktor/utils/logger.py, PHI mode) and this template's Convex console shim (convex/phiLogging.ts). Asserted by backend/viktor/utils/tests/test_phi_log_sanitization.py and scripts/phi-console-redaction.test.ts — change any side and the other side's tests must still pass against this file. Policy: scalars that cannot carry PHI pass through; runtime strings, objects, and arrays are redacted wholesale to the sentinel; messages built at runtime are replaced with dynamic_message_replacement; error type names and stack frames survive, error messages never do.

error_contract.must_survive: the error type name (and stack frames where the representation carries them)
